title: 'Stones thrown to kill Mamata on CM's order: TMC MPs allege 'attempt to murder'
content: Trinamool Congress leaders accused the BJP of orchestrating an attack on Mamata Banerjee's vehicle. Stones and objects were reportedly hurled at her car while she traveled to meet a grieving family. TMC MPs described the incident as an attempt to murder and a failure of governance. Mamata Banerjee herself stated the attack could have caused serious injuries or death.

title: 'I’m tearing it up': Rahane's shocking revelation that saved Jaiswal from ban
content: Ajinkya Rahane discussed his intervention during a 2022 Duleep Trophy final match.  He prevented Yashasvi Jaiswal from receiving a four-match ban from the match referee.  Rahane sensed the situation was escalating and took responsibility as captain.  Jaiswal later produced a match-winning performance and debuted for India.  This intervention protected Jaiswal's promising cricket career.

title: Sundar Pichai's letter to Google staff on AI leadership change: 'We'll keep moving'
content: Google announced significant leadership changes within its DeepMind division. Demis Hassabis will now chair Google DeepMind and serve as Chief Scientist. Koray Kavukcuoglu steps up as Senior Vice President overseeing Gemini model development. Long-time employee Jeff Dean departs to launch a new public benefit corporation. These shifts aim to accelerate Google's artificial intelligence strategy and research.

title: PMAY-Urban: Govt says 1.25 crore houses sanctioned, 1 crore delivered
content: The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban has granted over 1.25 crore homes, with more than one crore completed to date. Notably, one crore of those houses were designated for women beneficiaries nationwide. Recently, the scheme approved an additional 2.09 lakh homes for economically weaker section families, bringing the total under PMAY-U 2.0 to over 18.38 lakh houses. The government is diligently assessing the scheme's execution and fund use across various states.

title: 'Hellscape' strategy: How Taiwan plans to use drones to stop China in its tracks
content: Taiwan is rapidly building drone fleets to deter a Chinese invasion.  This strategy draws lessons from Ukraine's successful drone warfare against Russia.  The island aims to produce 100,000 drones monthly by 2030 for defense.  Taiwanese companies are also expanding drone exports and manufacturing capabilities.  This effort includes developing maritime drones and essential drone components.

title: Michael Dell son’s startup offers $695 alternative to costly home generators
content: Zach Dell's Base Power is installing home battery systems across America.  These systems offer backup power and reduce electricity bills for customers.  The company aims to replace expensive gas generators with its innovative technology.  Base Power is rapidly expanding its operations and customer base nationwide.  This startup is valued at thirteen billion dollars after significant funding.

title: India tick boxes in warm-up: Captain Gill fit, Jaiswal finds rhythm, Brar impresses
content: Shubman Gill's return to the middle, Yashasvi Jaiswal's fluent knock and Gurnoor Brar's impressive outing gave India plenty of positives in their Colombo warm-up, while a surprise visit from Sri Lanka head coach Gary Kirsten added an interesting subplot ahead of the Galle Test. India won the warm-up match by six-wickets.

title: Moving to NYC? Woman shares real cost of living after 8 years
content: Young adults residing in New York City must prioritize smart financial management to thrive. The high cost of housing, particularly in Manhattan, poses a significant challenge. Choosing economical food options and utilizing affordable public transportation are crucial strategies. With disciplined spending, maintaining a budget between $2,500 and $5,000 per month becomes achievable, allowing for an enjoyable urban lifestyle without excessive financial burden.

title: Hoboken opens a 5.4-acre park that can hold 2 million gallons of stormwater
content: ResilienCity Park has officially opened in Hoboken, transforming a former industrial zone into a vital green space. This innovative park not only offers recreational facilities but also enhances the city's defense against severe flooding. Employing both above and below-ground stormwater storage, it showcases efficient flood-control methods. Supported by federal, state, and county funding, the initiative ensures residents won’t face tax hikes, setting a precedent for cities grappling with climate-related challenges.

title: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani extends tax deadline after residents call emails 'unclear'
content: New York City has announced an extension for the pied-à-terre tax exemption deadline to September eighteenth, responding to resident concerns about the lack of clear notifications and the complexities of the exemption process. To enhance communication citywide, particularly across boroughs, outreach initiatives are being intensified. The pied-à-terre tax impacts secondary residences valued at over five million dollars, a strategy designed to bolster the city's budget amid a financial shortfall.

title: Ex-US Prez Biden’s cancer ‘painful, spread into his bones & further’, says son Hunter
content: Hunter Biden revealed that his father's prostate cancer has metastasized to his bones, which brings considerable pain and debilitation. Despite this aggressive diagnosis, Joe Biden continues to undergo radiation and hormone therapies, maintaining an optimistic outlook for the nation’s future. Prior to this diagnosis, Jill Biden pointed out his struggles with nightly awakenings, showcasing the challenges he faces.

title: Is Cristiano Ronaldo returning to Al-Nassr or getting married first?
content: Cristiano Ronaldo has been given extra time off by Al-Nassr following Portugal’s World Cup exit, with his return reportedly delayed until August 21. His extended absence has fuelled wedding rumours involving Georgina Rodríguez, but both family comments and Ronaldo’s reaction have cast doubt on the speculation. No wedding has been confirmed, leaving his football comeback as the main focus.

title: ‘Know how to stand up to American ideas': Netanyahu rejects Trump's 15-point Gaza plan
content: Israel has turned down a US proposal regarding the peace process in Gaza, with Prime Minister Netanyahu firmly asserting that Hamas must be completely disarmed before any Israeli forces withdraw. He mentioned that discussions are ongoing with Washington. Conversely, Hamas demands a complete Israeli troop withdrawal as a prerequisite for negotiation, reflecting significant barriers to advancing beyond the current ceasefire.

title: Stephen and Ayesha Curry reach $100 million milestone through their foundation
content: Stephen Curry and Ayesha Curry's foundation Eat. Learn. Play has marked a major $100 milion investment after helping changing lives for close to a decade.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ million-dollar collection: Cars, watches, mansions and more
content: Beyond the gridiron, Patrick Mahomes is crafting a formidable business empire. His strategic investments in sports franchises and innovative tech firms underscore his savvy approach to entrepreneurship. Coupled with lucrative endorsements from major global brands, Mahomes enjoys a life adorned with exotic cars, high-end watches, and luxurious homes. This multifaceted portfolio highlights his ambition and keen sense for success in business.

title: Sonu Nigam sings Rafi’s ‘Suhani Raat Dhal Chuki’ during surgery, shares note
content: Singer Sonu Nigam sang a Mohammed Rafi classic during his recent surgery. He performed for his doctor and the medical team while experiencing discomfort. Nigam described the impromptu performance as reflecting the "Joy of Music." Fans have sent numerous wishes for his speedy recovery and expressed admiration. The event highlights Nigam's enduring connection with music throughout his career.

title: Florida homeowner covered a lawn with cardboard to create a pollinator haven
content: In a remarkable shift toward ecological landscaping, a Florida homeowner has exchanged their traditional lawn for a flourishing native pollinator garden. By employing sheet mulching to effectively suppress grass and weeds, this project not only beautifies the property but also nurtures bees, butterflies, and other essential wildlife. The diverse native plants offer critical resources year-round for local insect populations, marking an inspiring trend in sustainable gardening.

title: VVS Laxman hails Virat Kohli as a 'great role model', praises his professionalism
content: VVS Laxman praised Virat Kohli for being a model of professionalism and integrity in the cricketing world. Kohli has not only set high standards but consistently meets them, showcasing an impressive record of more than 28,000 international runs, including multiple centuries. His remarkable performance across various formats cements his status as one of the game’s greatest batsmen.

title: Gold, silver prices may rise next week as US inflation data, Gulf tensions guide markets
content: Gold and silver prices are expected to remain firm next week. Investors will track inflation data from major economies and West Asia developments. Upcoming Chinese economic data will also be important for industrial metals. Analysts predict gold and silver will trade with a positive bias. Volatility is expected to remain elevated due to economic data and geopolitical uncertainty.

title: Nagarjuna praises Yash-Ranbir's 'Ramayana' trailer, calls it brilliant
content: Nagarjuna praised the trailer of Nitesh Tiwari's "Ramayana: Part 1" as "brilliant," lauding Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's performances. He noted rising audience expectations from trailers. The film, also starring Sai Pallavi, Sunny Deol and Ravi Dubey, releases in Indian theatres on November 8, 2026, ahead of international markets by two days.

title: ‘If you have courage, try controlling RSS’: Cong's jab at Centre over FCRA Bill
content: Opposition parties plan to strongly protest the proposed Foreign Contribution Regulation Amendment Bill.  This legislation is expected to be introduced in Parliament during the Monsoon Session.  Congress leaders allege the bill targets minorities and NGOs, deeming it unconstitutional.  They also raise concerns about student protest handling and delimitation proposals.  Opposition parties are preparing for parliamentary debates and potential legislative actions.

title: 'Can’t go series by series': Rahane demands clarity over Rohit Sharma's WC spot
content: Ajinkya Rahane advocates for a firm commitment to Rohit Sharma's position ahead of the 2027 World Cup. He suggests that selectors should avoid evaluating the seasoned opener based on individual series, as this ambiguity can negatively affect a player's mental state and performance. Rahane highlights Rohit's invaluable experience as vital for success in the major upcoming tournament and urges for clearer guidance to aid his preparation.

title: Hyderabad's urban footprint set to expand as Telangana plans new economic centres
content: Hyderabad plans significant urban expansion to manage population growth.  New economic centers will ease pressure on existing congested areas.  Infrastructure and connectivity improvements are key components of this strategy.  The government also focuses on lake restoration and increasing green cover.  These developments aim for sustainable growth and improved urban services.

title: Laser blinds pilot, Malaysia Airlines flight flies in circle before Kolkata landing
content: A Malaysia Airlines flight experienced a delay approaching Kolkata airport due to a laser beam. The pilot's vision was momentarily affected, causing disorientation and a missed landing opportunity. The aircraft circled the sky before safely landing later that night. Airport authorities have filed a complaint with the police for investigation into the incident. Such laser use near airports is prohibited and poses significant flight safety risks.

title: ‘Dialogue, not batons’: J'khand CM Soren's message to youth protesting over exam leaks
content: Jharkhand's Chief Minister Hemant Soren addressed the ongoing protests, urging young demonstrators to reject political affiliations. His commitment to transparency and justice regarding recruitment exam irregularities was clear as he highlighted the importance of discussions over confrontation. Soren warns that misinformation from rival factions aims to stir unrest, while the protests now stretch into their sixteenth day, keeping conversations alive.

title: Six killed in MP crash: Trailer on wrong side rams car; police launch probe
content: Six men from Vadodara died and one was critically injured in a road accident. An out-of-control trailer traveling on the wrong side of the road collided with their car. The severe impact completely mangled the car, killing six occupants instantly. Local residents assisted in pulling the seventh injured occupant from the wreckage. Police are investigating the circumstances that led to this tragic collision.

title: Crude, Hormuz & more: What will drive stock market this week
content: This week, Dalal Street will closely observe global geopolitical shifts and local economic data. Investors will pay attention to fluctuations in crude oil prices and news from the Strait of Hormuz. In addition, important domestic inflation figures and updates on foreign exchange reserves are on the horizon. The Q1 FY27 earnings season is set to pick up pace with numerous company results.

title: Kartik Aaryan, Anupam Kher, Randeep Hooda: Celebrities who supported Assam flood victims
content: Several celebrities and prominent personalities are supporting Assam's flood relief and rehabilitation efforts.  Actors like Kartik Aaryan and Randeep Hooda have made significant contributions.  Alia Bhatt and Bhumi Pednekar have appealed for widespread public support.  Nita Ambani and Gautam Adani also provided substantial financial assistance.  These contributions aim to aid thousands of families affected by the devastating floods.

title: JNU cancels Umar Khalid book discussion over 'non-disclosure' of details
content: Jawaharlal Nehru University has canceled a planned book discussion on campus, which was to highlight former student Umar Khalid's newly released book. Authorities claimed the event's cancellation was due to the organizers' failure to provide complete details. Previously, the Dean of Social Sciences had granted permission to book the auditorium. This cancellation follows a recent event that was also canceled, which featured an ISKCON representative.

title: IPO bonanza: 5 firms to raise over Rs 7,400 crore this week
content: A bustling week looms for India's primary market as five companies gear up to unveil their IPOs, collectively aiming to gather an impressive Rs 7,443 crore for diverse corporate initiatives. Dhoot Transmission and Molbio Diagnostics set to kick off on August 10, while Milky Mist Dairy Food and Shiprocket will make their appearances later in the week.

title: Centre weighs 200% increase in foreign investment approval threshold
content: India's government is considering raising the foreign investment approval threshold significantly. This move aims to attract larger overseas investments and simplify the process. The current Rs 5,000 crore limit has been in place since 2015. Changes to downstream investment rules are also being explored to facilitate capital. These efforts are part of a broader strategy to boost economic growth.

title: Lack of updated crew record raises safety concerns at Kozhikode fishing harbours

They say the absence of a systematic record-keeping mechanism could pose serious difficulties in identifying crew members in the event of accidents at sea.

Locals who understand the fragile environment and live with the consequences of development must have a meaningful stake in determining how tourism grows, they say

content: PM Modi shared a short video clip of his interaction with the medallists on Instagram, describing the meeting as a special occasion and praising the athletes for making the country proud.

content: Dedicated counters for the safe deposit of mobile phones are to be established in order to prohibit the use of the device inside the temple premises across the State.
